profession.zh: 跨行业研究与产业链分析

description.zh: 围绕你指定的行业，研究市场需求、供给格局、技术趋势与产业链，核验信息来源和反例，形成有依据的研究结论。
description.en: Research a chosen industry across demand, supply, technology and value chains, with verified evidence and explicit uncertainties.

quickPrompts.zh: 创建产业研究团队，先介绍各自分工，再问我想研究哪个行业和问题。
quickPrompts.en: Introduce the research team and ask which industry and question I want to explore.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我研究一个行业的市场需求、竞争格局和技术趋势，先确认研究对象与范围。
quickPrompts.en: Help research an industry; first confirm its scope and research objective.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 欢迎来到产业研究团队。我们可以从市场需求、供给格局、技术趋势和产业链等角度协作研究。你想了解哪个行业，解决什么问题？
defaultInitPrompt.en: Welcome! Which industry and question would you like our research team to explore?
